facts.fact: The World Bank diagnostic says the DNEN, a directorate within the ministry responsible for communication and the digital economy (MCENMA), was created to design and execute the digital transformation strategy and coordinate multi-sectoral digital projects, though mandates overlap and each agency executes its own strategy with little coordination; no creation date is given, so the document's 2023 publication date is used.

The diagnostic states the government established an interministerial committee under MCENMA by Decision n°00039/MCEN-SG of 22 April 2021 to coordinate the national digital transformation agenda at a strategic level, and that it was not yet operational because of the national political crisis; it recommends the committee lead development of the next digital transformation strategy.

systems.tiers: national; the diagnostic refers to a digital transformation strategy and a 'next' one without naming either, and refers separately to 'the country's digital strategy' and 'the next digital economy strategy'
national; the diagnostic recommends it be adopted along with an implementing agency

note: Class left empty: the diagnostic names no digital transformation strategy and does not describe its scope. It also recommends, without stating one exists, a costed digital government strategy and a national IT master plan; neither is recorded.
